* '''Mission''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Triads.png]][[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Ice Cold Killa|Ice Cold Killa]]
* '''Location''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Triads.png]]Pier 69, Esplanade North, San Fierro
|}

Go up the stairs with Cesar, and after the cutscene, use a sniper rifle to take out the six targets as quickly as possible. After another cutscene, you have to kill T-Bone. After another cutscene, you have to chase Ryder in a boat, and kill him. When returning to the shore, be careful not to land at the Easter Bay naval base, or you'll get a 5-star wanted level.

'''Note''': If you kill the Woozie's gang, you failed the mission.

== Tips ==
* After clearing up the roof, you can stay there and use the sniper rifle to take out some of the ground force too.
* You don't need to get wet with Ryder. Snipe him out while he is swimming to save a boat chase.
* if you're low on health, just go and visit the local well stacked pizza.

== Rewards ==
* '''Cash''': $15,000
* '''Respect''': +40
